title: 부동산에서 집 보기: 집주인이 뭐라고 했대요?
objective: Ask about sunlight, fees, and move-in; report with -대요.
summary: An agent shows an apartment and relays the landlord's words.
setting: A real estate agent (중개사) shows a customer (손님) a two-room apartment and passes on information from the landlord.

task.title: Use the words and -대요
task.line: Read the dialogue again, then pass on what people said with -대요 / -ㄴ대요 or use the new words to complete each item.

words.exampleMeaning: The boiler broke, so I contacted the landlord.

words.meaning: to get sunlight (sun comes into a room)
words.example: 북쪽 방이라서 햇빛이 거의 안 들어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's a north-side room, so it gets almost no sunlight.

words.meaning: monthly maintenance fee for a building
words.example: 이번 달 관리비가 지난달보다 많이 나왔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: This month's maintenance fee came out much higher than last month's.

words.meaning: to be included (in a fee or price)
words.exampleMeaning: Is the internet bill included in the monthly rent too?
When should we set the move-in date?

words.example: 이사 오기 전에 도배를 새로 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: We put up new wallpaper before moving in.

dialogue.meaning: This is the two-room place I told you about earlier. Come in.
It's bigger than I thought. Do the windows face south?

dialogue.korean: 네, 남향이라서 낮에는 햇빛이 잘 들어요. 집주인 말로는 겨울에도 별로 안 춥대요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes. They face south, so the place gets a lot of sun during the day. The landlord says it isn't very cold even in winter.
How much does the maintenance fee usually come to?

dialogue.korean: 정확한 금액은 다시 알려 드릴게요. 관리비에 수도 요금이 포함돼 있대요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll let you know the exact amount later. I'm told the water bill is included in the maintenance fee.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 입주는 언제부터 가능해요? 벽지도 좀 낡은 것 같은데요.
dialogue.meaning: Then when could I move in? The wallpaper looks a bit old, too.

dialogue.korean: 집주인 말로는 다음 달 초부터 입주할 수 있대요. 도배도 새로 해 준대요.
dialogue.meaning: The landlord says you can move in from early next month. He says he'll put up new wallpaper, too.

exercises: Pass on what the landlord said. Use -대요 after adjectives and 있다, and use -ㄴ대요 after verb stems that end in a vowel: ① "엘리베이터가 있어요." ② "이 동네는 조용해요." ③ "지금 사는 사람이 이번 주말에 나가요."
Choose the right word: 벽지가 너무 낡아서 들어가기 전에 (도배 / 입주)를 하고 싶어요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 고쳐 준대요 / 집주인이 / 보일러를 / 계약 전에
Fill in the blank with the same verb the customer uses in the dialogue to ask about the monthly maintenance fee: 관리비가 한 달에 얼마나 ____?
answers: ① 엘리베이터가 있대요. ② 이 동네는 조용하대요. ③ 지금 사는 사람이 이번 주말에 나간대요.
집주인이 계약 전에 보일러를 고쳐 준대요. (또는: 계약 전에 집주인이 보일러를 고쳐 준대요.)
